question: 우리 프로젝트에서 Qwen을 선택한 이유는 무엇인가요? 다른 모델보다 더 우수하다고 검증했나요?

turn.text: The project chose Qwen based on its configurability and local deployment flexibility, as indicated in the reviewed QA-records. However, there is no verified evidence in the source records that Qwen outperforms other models in this specific project context.

citations.title: Configurable local dialogue model
citations.text: The local demo adapter defaults to an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint at localhost port 8103 and allows an explicitly configured external LLM endpoint. The launcher runs mlx_lm.server with locally registered model files; the selected model identity comes from the local runtime metadata. The adapter adds source-bound persona-card observations and conditional decision notes, with bounded response length. This configuration does not establish that Qwen outperforms other models or prove the team's selection rationale.
